notes: Use source monster native rank through 4 only. Do not invent earlier availability.

Each series concept art has one complete adult neutral mannequin armor set and SEVEN distinct separated weapon families. Native-rank reference sheet. All rank variants receive explicit geometry/material evolution in JSON and final book. Do not call it orthographic/finished3D.
